title: My Science Class
text: Every Friday, I have science class. Today, we do an experiment with a magnet, and we observe how it pulls a metal spoon. Then I plant a seed in a cup. It needs air and energy from the sun to grow. My teacher says the seed will grow into a plant with a green leaf. After that, we talk about solid, liquid, and gas. Ice is a solid, water is a liquid, and steam is a gas, and they are all matter. Then we build a toy car with a battery, and the wheels turn with electricity. Science is my favorite class of the week!
